item.title: A small tool can explain one idea well
item.description:
This example shows how a short note can sit alongside projects and teaching resources. Replace it with an observation, a question, or something useful from your own work.

A connection worth sharing

A note can point readers to an interactive project or a related course topic. It can also record why a tool or an authoring approach was useful in a particular situation.

Leave room for follow-up

A few paragraphs are enough. A later note can revisit the idea as your experience develops.
